title: Initial focus for our partnership with Motorola is a regular non-folding device
author: Cider9986
content:
To use the Mastodon web application, please enable JavaScript. Alternatively, try one of the
native apps
for Mastodon for your platform.
summary: The partnership with Motorola is set to focus on developing a traditional non-folding smartphone device, aiming to leverage their combined expertise in the mobile technology sector.
